tonic.description: Restores some of an ally's HP.
tonic.flavor: A mouthful, then someone checks the wrist again.

mid_tonic.description: Restores more of an ally's HP than a Tonic.
mid_tonic.flavor: Enough to stand; not an excuse to keep standing.

ether.flavor: For the kind of tired a bottle can reach.

revive.description: Revives a fallen ally with part of their HP restored.
revive.flavor: Save the lecture until they're sitting up.

cobalt_wash.description: Clears Ink Blot, reveals hidden washi paths and paints untouchable paper foes.
cobalt_wash.flavor: Blue admits what white paint keeps denying.

time_atom.description: Repairs a small amount of Crono's porcelain integrity.
time_atom.flavor: A speck of time that can still be given back.

tungsten_scrap.description: Provides tungsten bracer material for crafting.
tungsten_scrap.flavor: Lucca kept jars for this sort of almost-nothing.

thoracic_ring_part.description: Provides a salvaged component for a later arm cannon.
thoracic_ring_part.flavor: The masks still count it as theirs.

bekkler_doll_small.description: Unlocks the training doll's Amber Rift and the choice to keep a vial when sealing Krona's vein.
bekkler_doll_small.flavor: At six, she picked the prize with Papa's hair.

gold_leaf_memory_flake.description: Combines with Cobalt Nodachi pigment for Crono's Gold Leaf repair in the Bone-Tree.
gold_leaf_memory_flake.flavor: The hearth went cold; the shape of home didn't.

vaelos_tooth.flavor: A clean young voice from a mouth that isn't there.

lavos_fibre_wrap.description: Strengthens Krona's Defiled Masamune with fibre torn from the Daimyo.
lavos_fibre_wrap.flavor: Strong binding. Keep eyes on blade.

cobalt_nodachi.description: Unlocks Krona's cobalt strike, reveals hidden Chronoslips and opens a portal back to U1.
cobalt_nodachi.flavor: One sunrise sharpened into something she can carry.

tungsten_wire_loom_bracer.description: Increases damage dealt just after an enemy is Broken.
tungsten_wire_loom_bracer.flavor: It came loose when the house finally unclenched.

epoch_gauntlet.description: Can be overcharged to unleash an Astral burst.
epoch_gauntlet.flavor: The wing-core flies no farther than his wrist now.

matriarch_seed.description: Thaws one Ruin stack from an ally; a seed has three uses.
matriarch_seed.flavor: She gives it only when left broken and unburned.

gold_bundle.description: Eases Crono's glaze erosion when used at a lotus pond.
gold_bundle.flavor: Gold folded small enough to carry home.
gold_bundle.found: Dropped by Kirie Keepers in U7.

gold_leaf_flake.description: Provides gold leaf for kintsugi work.
gold_leaf_flake.flavor: It settles like a number on the HP bar.
gold_leaf_flake.found: Dropped by broken Bekkler Doll Failed.

charred_laurel_fragment.description: Provides a sprig of Cyrus's crest toward the Charred Laurel.
charred_laurel_fragment.flavor: The corn at the Sweetcorn Pope's stall tastes of it.

ferro_capacitor.description: Provides a magnetic component for Cassia-09's workbench.
ferro_capacitor.flavor: Still warm from a race nobody won.

batteries.description: Provides spare power cells for antennas and radios.
batteries.flavor: Static leaves them where the children will find them.

conductivity_gel.description: Provides a conductive paste for wiring and repairs.
conductivity_gel.flavor: It smells of oden steam and ozone.
conductivity_gel.found: Dropped by the RAM Fixer Twins.

kirie_scales.description: Counts toward the hundred scales that reveal Kami-Ori's seventh arm.
kirie_scales.flavor: Torn kimono silk that still remembers being worn.

prop_hammer.description: Lets Glenn learn the Prop Hammer and works the lever above Cyrus's stage.
prop_hammer.flavor: Painted to look heavy; it is heavier than it looks.

red_bike_chain.description: Restores part of the Red Bike's drive.
red_bike_chain.flavor: Oil-fire still ticks between the links.
red_bike_chain.found: Dropped by the Oil-Fire Bike Bro.

gramophone_record_crono_lullaby.description: Plays the lullaby Crono once hummed to a doll.
gramophone_record_crono_lullaby.flavor: The groove is cut in a voice that never aged.
gramophone_record_crono_lullaby.found: Dropped by the Paradox Curator Choir.

assembled_seed.description: Plants the Seed of Doan so it can grow.
assembled_seed.flavor: It hums at the pitch of an unbroken egg.

torso_heart_9999.description: Lets R-66Y's upgraded heart hold the Atrium in the siege.
torso_heart_9999.flavor: He asked to become the tower, and meant it.

chrono_prism_fragment.description: Provides a shard of the cathedral's prism for Vesper's light.
chrono_prism_fragment.flavor: Seven colours, and one of them is grief.

long_pull.description: A relic of R-66Y's long reach.
long_pull.flavor: The arm remembers every rescue it was too slow for.

grief_filter.description: Blocks Grief's MP drain in the Geno-Foundry, and later halves Grief everywhere.
grief_filter.flavor: A mask that weeps so its wearer does not have to.

syringe_heart_key.description: Opens the way to the true Lavos in U0's endgame.
syringe_heart_key.flavor: Every syringe in the foundry is dated; this one is not.

charred_laurel.description: Pristine, it lets Sera slip without an anchor in burn zones; blackened, it drains BP in U6 and unlocks Prop Cannon.
charred_laurel.flavor: Funny is cracked window light gets in.

bubble_lens.description: Lets the party cross U4 without the drowning timer and defeats the cathedral adds.
bubble_lens.flavor: A breath held in glass for whoever needs it.

vapor_memory_core_fragment.description: Holds a sliver of Crono's vaporized atoms for the re-parenting ending.
vapor_memory_core_fragment.flavor: The net kept what the rain took.

kintsugi_brush.description: Makes every kintsugi repair restore more integrity.
kintsugi_brush.flavor: The bristles are his; the gold is borrowed.

null_shield.description: Lets an ally trade every weakness and resistance for a flat reduction to all damage.
null_shield.flavor: The Faceless teaches that no face is still a face.
